description: Create ONE draft record (data validated against the collection schema). Non-destructive. Enforces the max_records cap.

data.description: Record field values, validated against the collection schema. Unknown fields are rejected with a warning.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

seo_title.description: SEO <title> for the record detail page.

slug.description: URL-safe record slug (unique within the collection).

workspace.description: Workspace/brand to act on (defaults to your active workspace).

name: collection_record_create
